disclosures.said: Some of the pictures have thin dashed outlines drawn in by the camera tool that took them. Disregard those dashed outlines — only the solid coloured boxes with a tag matter.

screen1-a1.where: the three lines in the top left corner
screen1-a1.expectation: Opens the side menu with the rest of the app in it.
screen1-a1.cue: The three-lines picture - every app I use has it there.

first_pass.why: I know this one without thinking.

screen1-a2.where: the little ghost outline in the top right corner
screen1-a2.expectation: Maybe some kind of hidden or private chat? Or it could be something fun that pops up. I honestly would have to press it to find out.
screen1-a2.cue: Only the ghost picture. No word anywhere near it.

first_pass.why: A ghost could mean a lot of things - private, hidden, deleted, a game. Up in the corner with no word, I either skip it or tap it just to see, and then I've lost my train of thought.
first_pass.solution: Put one word under or beside it, like 'Private chat', so I know before I tap.

test_cases.targets: whether anything tells you what the ghost does before it changes the screen, or only afterwards
test_cases.action: Start from the main screen (the one with the typing box at the bottom). If you are not there, press the three lines at the top left and then 'New chat'. Hold your finger on the ghost at the top right for about a second and watch for any words. Then read what the screen now says. To go back, press the same corner control again.
test_cases.problem_is_real_if: no words name it before anything changes, and you only find out what it did after it has done it
test_cases.problem_is_not_real_if: words appear (on holding, or near it) that tell you what it does before anything changes
test_cases.what_happened: I started on the main screen and held my finger on the ghost for over a second. No words popped up and nothing appeared near it. It just switched straight away: the ghost turned into an X, 'Incognito chat' showed at the top, and the middle said 'Incognito chats stay out of your history and search, and aren't used to train Claude', with a 'Learn more' link. So I only found out what it was after it had done it. The explanation was short and clear, though, and pressing the X in the same corner took me straight back to the normal screen. Easy to undo.

screen1-a2.closing_comment: Nothing told me what the ghost did until it had already done it, but it's only a private-chat switch that explains itself clearly and undoes with one tap, so it's smaller than I feared.

screen1-a3.expectation: Takes me to pay for the Pro version.

first_pass.why: It says exactly what it does.
